# PHP 2FA
> Framework-agnostic two-factor authentication (TOTP) for PHP with optional Laravel support.

## Docs

- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/configuration: Configuration
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/custom-encryptor: Custom Encryptor
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/actions: Individual Actions
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/installation: Installation
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/laravel: Laravel Usage
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/: PHP 2FA
- https://mrpunyapal.github.io/php-2fa/quick-start: Quick Start (Vanilla PHP)
